recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in traditional Western attire sitting on the polished mahogany deck of a vintage wooden boat, set against dark, reflective water. The composition uses a high-contrast lighting scheme with a warm, nostalgic color grade.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the left third looking toward the right edge
Textual elements anchored in the dark negative space on the right
Contrast between the cool blue plaid shirt and the warm red wood of the boat
Diagonal line created by the boat's edge leading from bottom left to mid-right
coreInvariants: Dark water with high-contrast specular reflections
Blue and white vertical-striped or plaid shirt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, seated and leaning forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white cowboy hat serves as the primary focal point against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the hat, moves down the subject's body to the boat, then follows the boat's diagonal line to the text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark water on the right side provide a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep mahogany red and dark navy water provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (hat and text) provides immediate visual pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue (shirt and jeans) adds a cool-toned mid-ground.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's hat and the dark background; high saturation in the wood tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant synthetic colors
Stick to organic earth tones and denim blues

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, slab-like serifs with rounded terminals
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected handwriting style
Slight drop shadow or outer glow for legibility against dark backgrounds
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, masculine slab serif with a light, personal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab serif aesthetic of the 70s-90s
Provides the casual, handwritten script contrast
Alternative soft-serif with similar vintage feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with blonde hair and a mustache wearing a white cowboy hat and a blue plaid shirt, sitting on the red mahogany deck of a classic wooden boat. The background is dark, rippling water with golden reflections. High contrast, warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy, rounded slab serif font (like Cooper Black) in white with a soft drop shadow in the upper right. Add a subtitle below it in a thin, white handwritten script font.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat bright white?
Is the boat deck a rich, polished red wood?
Is the text placed in the dark water area on the right?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the bold name and the script title?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on clothing or boat

mustAchieve: Clean, legible typography against a dark background
Balanced composition between subject and negative space

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic wood grain and reflections
Ensure the hat shape is a classic western style
Verify the text does not overlap the subject's face
Confirm the color balance leans warm in the wood and cool in the clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Western Archetype] + Environment [Vintage Luxury Craft] + Lighting [High Contrast Golden Hour] + Layout [Rule of Thirds with Right-Aligned Slab Serif Typography]
